scientific_integrity: Analytic proof by finite symmetry averaging, spectral mode bounds and strict scalar minimax. All-size mathematics does not rely on numerical testing.
scientific_limitations: Only symmetric, loopless stochastic transitions on cyclic prisms; sharp asymptotic SLEM, not finite-time total-variation mixing; no global matrix uniqueness claim. The existence of equivalent unindexed historical work remains possible; independent audit not performed.
title: Exact fastest mixing without holding on every cyclic prism
